name: rhize-context-manager
description: Context engineering and optimization plugin — compression, management, retrieval, and storage. Orchestrates the Rhize context stack (Headroom wire compression, claude-mem global memory, OpenWolf per-repo indexing, Serena/CodeGraph semantic code navigation, RTK CLI compression, graphify knowledge graphs, opt-in Graphiti temporal memory) and ships a curated, safety-gated skill library covering context fundamentals, degradation, compression, optimization, retrieval, budgeting, and memory systems.
